user.title: Authentication Method
user.description: Choose how to authenticate with your Daze account.

credentials.title: Daze Account Login
credentials.description: Enter your Daze account email and password.

token.description:
Enter your Daze access token and refresh token.

You can obtain these from the Daze web portal (webportal.dazeservice.com) or the developer console.

confirm.title: Confirmation
confirm.description:
Network: **{network_name}**
Charger: **{evse_name}** ({serial_number})
Model: **{device_profile}**

Press Submit to finish setup.

error.invalid_token: The provided tokens are invalid or expired. Please check and try again.
error.invalid_credentials: Incorrect email or password. Please check and try again.
error.user_not_confirmed: This email address has not been confirmed. Please check your email for a confirmation link from Daze.
error.password_reset_required: A password reset is required. Please reset your password via the Daze app or web portal first.
error.too_many_requests: Too many authentication attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
error.network_error: Could not connect to the Daze API. Please check your internet connection and try again.
error.no_networks: No networks found for this account.
error.no_evses: No wallbox found in the selected network.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
